message.content:
The commits right after HEAD (0f48055c4) are 13ecc0725 (cookie UAF) and 02c6b984c (urlapi UAF). These are the two UAF fixes that come right after the vulnerable commit.

The `02c6b984c` (urlapi: fix use-after-free) is the most likely candidate for the `curl_fuzzer_http` issue, since it involves URL handling which is core to HTTP requests. The test 663 involves HTTP redirect with dotdots and whitespaces in absolute Location URL.

Let me look at the vulnerable code in urlapi.c to understand the UAF. The fix is a follow-up from commit 2c20109a9 (urlapi: fix URL encoding when setting a full URL), which is in the current HEAD.

Let me look at the current urlapi.c seturl function.
